Describe a useful skill you learned outside a formal class. You should say what it was, how you learned it, why you needed it, and explain how it has helped you.
Describe a person who gave you practical advice. You should say who the person was, what advice they gave, what situation you were in, and explain why the advice was useful.
Describe a project that was difficult but satisfying. You should say what the project was, who was involved, what difficulty you faced, and explain why you felt satisfied.
Describe a place where you can concentrate well. You should say where it is, what it is like, what you do there, and explain why it helps you concentrate.
